visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide, eye-level shot of a brightly lit indoor basketball gymnasium. In the foreground, a young boy in a gray t-shirt and black shorts is actively dribbling a basketball on a polished composite court with yellow and white markings. In the middle ground, a group of about ten children in various athletic jerseys are seated on the floor in a circle. A man in a vibrant green t-shirt stands with his back to the camera, gesturing with his hands while speaking to them. The background features a professional basketball hoop with a glass backboard and a digital scoreboard displaying 00:00. (2) The camera performs a slow digital zoom into the group of children seated on the court. A man with a dark beard and a white t-shirt sits among the kids, smiling and engaging in their conversation. The children, mostly boys, look attentive and relaxed, with some leaning on their hands. Their facial expressions are cheerful, indicating a friendly team environment. The lighting is bright and even across the court surface, coming from overhead fixtures and side windows. (3) The camera zooms back out to the original wide perspective. The boy on the left continues his steady dribbling, moving slightly in place. The coach in the green shirt continues his instructional speech, his posture upright and authoritative. The surrounding environment shows industrial ceiling beams and glass doors leading to an outdoor area, maintaining a clean and professional sports training atmosphere.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp, resonant thud of a basketball hitting a hard court surface, followed by the steady, percussive rhythm of continuous dribbling. An adult male voice speaks clearly in Mandarin, maintaining a moderate speech rate and a professional, instructional tone. The acoustic environment has a noticeable room reverb typical of a large gymnasium. (2) A sudden burst of light-hearted chatter and youthful laughter from the group of children breaks the monologue, indicating a positive social interaction. The coach's voice pitch remains stable but carries a friendly inflection as he continues to explain a basketball concept. The sound of the basketball dribbling continues as a constant percussive background texture. (3) The main speaker's voice becomes the primary focus again, delivering a series of instructional phrases with rising intonation to emphasize key points. Intermittent squeaks from rubber soles against the court surface are heard, along with the distant hum of the building's ventilation system. The overall sound quality is a clean field recording with a high signal-to-noise ratio.
